svg.title: V2 validation action-effect fidelity
svg.desc: Action-effect fidelity for New validation-only v2 records; All recorded fits completed. Held-out evaluation remains separate.. Two rows compare position and velocity changes from action zero. Each panel shows actual simulator changes as dashed lines and model predictions as colored lines for actions minus one, zero, and plus one. The plot uses 420 model-seed and context groups, with every seed shown separately.
svg.title: V2 validation action-effect fidelity
